_about: Which videos are used, for what, and the few values read off the footage by hand. Times are real seconds; frames are 0-based. 'fit' clips are used to fit the model, 'test' clips are held out and only predicted.

clips.notes: Duck on its back, glue-bottle nozzle pressed into the face (deep: the head caves in), held ~0.8 s, lifted fast.
clips.px_per_mm_note: lying head height: 420-423 px in A1/A2 vs 438 px in the ruler clip, where the ruler gives 8.4 px/mm (head = 52 mm) -> 8.1 px/mm (+-4%)

clips.notes: Same set-up as A1, shallower press, held ~1.5 s. Clip starts with the nozzle already touching.
clips.px_per_mm_note: lying head height: 420-423 px in A1/A2 vs 438 px in the ruler clip, where the ruler gives 8.4 px/mm (head = 52 mm) -> 8.1 px/mm (+-4%)

clips.notes: Duck upright, held at the base by hand, flat bottom of a glue bottle pressed down on the head. Side/back view. Bottle clear of the hat from frame 158 (read by eye).
clips.px_per_mm_note: duck height 110 mm = ~827 px (hat top y~13 to base y~840) in the last frame

clips.notes: Same set-up and view as B1; clip starts pressed. Bottle clear of the hat from frame 70 (read by eye).
clips.px_per_mm_note: base cut off; hat width ~440 px vs ~360 px in B1 (same side view) -> 7.5 x 1.22

clips.notes: Head press filmed from the FRONT (duck turned 90 deg). Head folds fully sideways and snaps back within ~3 frames. Hat hidden while pressed, so the press depth is not measurable.
clips.px_per_mm_note: same view and hat size as B2 in the last frame
